description: 시급을 월 209시간(주휴 포함) 기준 월급(원)으로 환산.
when_to_use: 시급을 월급으로, 최저임금 월 환산액을 볼 때.

properties.hours: optional: paid hours per MONTH (default 209 = 40 h/week incl. paid weekly rest). Leave it out for a standard full-time job; it is not hours per week.

description_en: Monthly wage (won) from an hourly wage at 209 hours a month (Korean standard, paid weekly rest included).
when_to_use_en: When converting an hourly wage, or the minimum wage, to a monthly wage.

hours.why: hours is paid hours per month; a value under 100 is almost always hours per week, so the standard 209 is used
